canonical_project: Crnogorski Telekom Data Center Podgorica / Telekom CG TGD01
notes: Crnogorski Telekom official colocation page states it offers server colocation in its Podgorica Data Center and a Bijelo Polje data recovery site. Vijesti reported the new modern data center opening in 2020. Inflect lists TGD01 in Podgorica and reports 150 kW power capacity; capacity should be treated as third-party directory data.
